_comment: V.I.E.W — Video source registry. Add any new video source here and restart the runtime. No code changes needed.

_schema.id: Unique camera ID (used as key across backend + frontend)
_schema.name: Display name shown in HUD
_schema.video_path: Path to MP4 file — relative to THIS sources.json, or absolute. For RTSP cameras use the rtsp:// URL here directly.
_schema.source_type: file (default) | rtsp — controls whether video_path is resolved as a filesystem path or used as-is
_schema.fps_target: Target FPS cap for inference loop (set lower on slow hardware)
_schema.enabled: Set false to skip this source without deleting it
